purpose.zh: 活动前臂，让手掌翻转更灵活、更好控制
purpose.en: Loosen your forearm so turning your palm feels freer and better controlled.

text.zh: 大臂不动，掌心转向上，再转向下
text.en: Keep your upper arm still and turn your palm up, then down

text.zh: 手肘弯着贴在身侧，手腕不弯。
text.en: Keep your elbow bent at your side and your wrist straight.

text.zh: 转到一头算 1 次，每到头停一下，慢慢转。
text.en: Each turn to one end counts as one. Pause at each end and turn slowly.

commonErrors.en: Turning from the shoulder instead of the forearm.
Letting the elbow drift away from your side.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If you feel pain, reduce the range, and stop if it continues.

changes: 英文名去掉术语 Pronation/Supination，改 Standing Forearm Rotation
口令改成每一下「转手掌-停-回中间」（每转一个方向算一次）；cue 去掉「中立」
计数单位保持不变，cue 写明 1 次是什么
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
